Scene: Copán Ruinas, Honduras. A 15-year-old girl with a wavy shoulder-length bob, rust T-shirt and jeans has breakfast with her elderly grandmother with short silver curls and green blouse at a modest clean outdoor café table near a leafy town plaza. Behind them, quiet low-rise pastel houses with tiled roofs and distant green hills. On the table show an open SOFT WHITE FLOUR TORTILLA folded loosely, visibly filled with refried beans and crumbled white cheese (a simple Honduran baleada), a clear glass of water, a small open notebook and a cloth shopping bag. A navy backpack leans beside the chair. The tortilla must be a soft flour flatbread, not a crispy taco, no rice filling. Make the plate, glass, backpack and notebook individually easy to identify. Warm peaceful morning.

Scene: Cartagena, Colombia. A 15-year-old boy with short tightly curled hair, turquoise T-shirt and dark shorts sits at a shaded family courtyard table with his younger sister with two small braids and yellow T-shirt. Low pastel Caribbean city buildings and leafy courtyard behind, glimpse of historic masonry wall far behind, no cathedral fantasy. Clear foreground plate with white coconut rice and a cooked fish, a bottle of water, a sturdy reusable canvas bag and a pair of protective cleaning gloves beside it. They have just come back from helping clean a beach. Modern ordinary family setting, no trash covered city, no dangerous tools. Make plate/rice, bottle, bag and gloves distinct and clickable.

Scene: Oaxaca city, Mexico. A 16-year-old girl with straight long dark hair in a low ponytail, simple denim shirt and cream pants visits a bright covered food market with her adult uncle wearing a plain white shirt. Clean ordinary market stalls with baskets of CORN COBS, PAPAYAS and TOMATOES, and one steaming mug of cocoa on a counter. Carefully separate corn, papaya, tomato and cocoa mug as visible foreground learning objects. Warm market light, tiled counter, colorful but restrained produce; people casually shopping behind. Contemporary realistic market, no sombreros, no Day of the Dead skeletons, no ponchos, no tourist caricatures. No fake readable signs.

Scene: Valencia, Spain. A 15-year-old teenager with short auburn hair, light blue shirt and dark trousers rests with their mother with shoulder-length brown curls in a green urban park built in a broad former riverbed. Contemporary city buildings and a modest historic stone bridge in background, orange trees and a cycle path, no water flowing under bridge in the park. A clearly visible bicycle beside them. On a small café table: a tall clear glass of creamy WHITE HORCHATA, a small plate of slender light golden FARTON pastries, and a notebook. Make bicycle, glass, pastries and orange tree fruit distinguishable learning objects. Fresh afternoon daylight, modern city and inviting calm; no flamenco costumes, bullfight imagery or beach clichés.

Scene: Cusco, Peru. A 16-year-old boy with straight black side-swept hair, mustard sweatshirt and dark jeans shops with his older aunt with short dark hair and burgundy cardigan at a covered everyday market. A vendor in a simple blue apron offers different shapes and colors of POTATOES in a foreground basket; alongside separate CORN COBS, a small stack of woven scarves and the boy's reusable fabric shopping bag. Plausible Cusco city roofs and distant Andean slopes glimpsed at the edge of market, with soft clear mountain daylight. Contemporary ordinary people, no llama beside stall, no everyone in traditional costume, no ruins fantasy. Make potato basket, corn, scarf and bag clearly separate clickable objects.

Scene: Bata, Equatorial Guinea. A 15-year-old Black African girl with short natural textured hair and a simple plum T-shirt and beige trousers sketches with her father with close-cropped hair and a light green shirt on a shaded seaside promenade beside the ATLANTIC OCEAN. Contemporary low-rise city frontage, palms, ocean horizon with a small fishing boat in the background. Foreground open sketchbook with simple non-text drawing, colored pencils in a cup, reusable bottle of water and two ripe plantains in a cloth bag. Make sketchbook, colored pencils, water bottle and plantains distinguishable learning objects; the distant boat can be a fifth. Ordinary family leisure, culturally respectful modern African coastal city, no safari animals, no huts, no tribal costumes, no poverty spectacle. Calm late-afternoon daylight.
